back: A fast-growing meat chicken (hybrid strain) slaughtered at about 5-7 weeks.
Feed eaten ÷ live-weight gain (both in kg). Lower is better.
Dressed carcass mass ÷ live mass × 100; broilers typically about 70-75%.
About 32-35 °C at chick level at first, falling about 3 °C a week; judge by the chicks' behaviour.
Crowding under heat = too cold; spread away and panting = too hot; huddled on one side = draught; evenly spread = correct.
Starter (crumbs, highest protein) → grower → finisher (pellets) until slaughter.
One batch of one age at a time; then clean, disinfect and rest the house to break disease cycles.
Starve 8-12 h (water given), kill humanely, bleed, scald, pluck, remove head and feet, eviscerate, wash, chill, pack.
